notes.title: Sub Terra Draconis, now in Portuguese
notes.content:
Sub Terra Draconis is now available in [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b], thanks to the efforts of Gabriel Lima.

Aside from that, this patch includes bugfixes as follows,
[list]
[*]Fixed Hatchling achievement unlocking too early.
[*]Fixed hintbox maximum width, quicksave button in editor.
[*]Fixed workshop license popup on Steam, incremental achiemevents on GOG.
[*]Adjusted hint text in Seven Seas of Rhye.
[/list]

notes.title: Sub Terra Draconis updated to v1.2
